runtimeLease: Only the coordinator can transfer the sole runtime lease. No flag grants it.
launchRequirements: Prove a credential-free launcher using only dummy fixtures before any product execution.
Clear inherited environment, use exact pinned executables, scratch HOME and TMPDIR, and closed stdin.
Populate approved-bin only with sealed, identity-pinned wrappers. Every Bun invocation and descendant must include --no-env-file --no-install.
Reject absolute child Bun launches that omit required flags; PATH wrappers alone do not enforce this.
Reject historical qualification and archive drivers until every descendant command and child wait is reconciled.
Own process groups, bound every command with timeout -k 10 at no more than 540 seconds, wait all owned children, and record bounded census limits.
Capture compiler and consumer stdout in declared files; compare complete bytes through EOF twice.
Require a passing baseline, intended diagnostic or assertion, and exact byte/mode restoration for every negative and control.
